'''Griggs Pe'et''' was a [[Balosar (species)/Legends|Balosar]] who met [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] at [[Kislov's Gambling Palace]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. Pe'et wanted Solo to get a "valuable shipment" from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] satellite. When asked what the shipment was, Pe'et said that it was "not a concern of Solo's." [[Ferus Olin]], not Pe'et, really wanted Solo to go to the satellite. Ferus paid Pe'et, convincing Pe'et to get Solo to go to the satellite.
